---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- read_csv(
  "data/mallards.csv",
  col_types = cols(timestamp = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = ymd_hms(timestamp),
    month = month(timestamp, label = TRUE),
    month_num = month(timestamp),
    year = year(timestamp),
    season = case_when(
      month_num %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
      month_num %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
      month_num %in% 9:11 ~ "Autumn",
      month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Autumn"))
  )

saveRDS(mallards, "data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(duck_id, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  summarise(
    min_latitude = min(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_latitude = max(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_longitude = min(long, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_longitude = max(long, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
mallards_region <- mallards |>
  filter(between(lat, 47, 55), between(long, 8, 25))

countries <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = countries, fill = "gray95", color = "gray60") +
  geom_point(
    data = mallards_region,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, color = duck_id),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 0.7
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(8, 25), ylim = c(47, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard GPS fixes",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "Duck"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
